integrity: All-size theorem proved by local wall recurrence, cyclic composition enumeration, transfer matrix and independent-projection probability bounds; finite trajectory checks are corroborative, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Synchronous binary rings of size at least three only; asymptotic entry-time convergence in probability, not a fluctuation law; qualitative wall invasion, two-cycle convergence and even-ring two-step conjugacy are prior results; novelty conclusions are bounded by accessible sources.
title: Exact relaxation shells and a logarithmic typical clock for cyclic Rule 178
